sentences.text: Shri Madhur Bhargav - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Rajiv Upadhyay - Pp for the respondent No.1/State.
I.A. No.12061/2024, an application for taking the documents on record is considered and allowed.
Petitioner has filed this first application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.

Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with offence punishable under Sections 120-B, 420,
467, 468, 471, 406 of the IPC in connection with Crime No.905/2023 (RCT), registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Guna (M.P.).
Notice be sent to the respondent No.2.
Case diary is not available despite this case has been filed on 11.06.2024.
The non-availability of the case diary is attributed to the State.
Let the case be taken up in the next week.

Till then, this court is inclined to extend benefit of interim anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Consequently, as an interim measure, it is hereby directed that in case of arrest, petitioner shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rs. Twenty Five Thousand only) with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority.
